scope: Raw encounter statistics; input kind and frozen provenance recorded per source. No network, legal route, prepared Boss or human UX claim.

frozen_inputs.StrategyPolicy: baseline_all_hand spends immediately; basic/build wait for three cards or two core cards above 25% HP, then score legal visible subsets

Decks.Ownership: one enabled codex copy per selected card
one enabled codex copy per selected card

limitations: Sample budget is not a precision guarantee.
Intervals are descriptive per stratum; no preregistered primary endpoint or multiple-comparison plan was supplied.
Victory-only quantiles do not establish an all-started TTK tail with censoring or competing outcomes.

victory_ttk_p95_all_started.method: nearest-rank among all starts; death never becomes victory; censored outcomes must not alter the rank; no independent-censoring assumption
